skills.name: Negate Poison

skills.name: Double Paralysis

skills.name: Negate Sleep

skills.name: Double Stun

skills.description_zh: 使大型怪物的所有咆哮无效。

skills.name: Windproof (Hi)

skills.name: Cold Cancel

skills.description_zh: 因寒冷导致的最大耐力槽降低这一效果将变得更强。

skills.name: Polar Hunter
skills.description: Powers you up in the cold. If you drink a Cool Drink...
skills.description_zh: 不畏寒冷，在寒冷的地方会变得更强。如果喝了冷饮的话……

skills.name: Tropic Hunter

skills.description: Increases the power of Bowgun Internal Ammo, and the Bow's Arc Shot and Power Shot.
skills.description_zh: 提升弩的武器内藏弹以及弓的曲射、刚射的威力。

skills.name: Ammo Saver
skills.description: Occasionally returns ammo or phials to inventory when firing.
skills.description_zh: 射击时，偶尔会不消耗子弹和瓶。

skills.name: Critical Eye +3
skills.description: Increases Affinity by 30%.
skills.description_zh: 会心率增加30%。

skills.name: Critical Eye +2
skills.description: Increases Affinity by 20%.
skills.description_zh: 会心率增加20%。

skills.name: Critical Eye +1
skills.description: Increases Affinity by 10%.
skills.description_zh: 会心率增加10%。

skills.name: Critical Eye -1
skills.description: Decreases Affinity by 5%.
skills.description_zh: 会心率降低5%。

skills.name: Critical Eye -2
skills.description: Decreases Affinity by 10%.
skills.description_zh: 会心率降低10%。

skills.name: Critical Eye -3
skills.description: Decreases Affinity by 15%.
skills.description_zh: 会心率降低15%。

skills.name: Weakness Exploit
skills.description: Increases Affinity when striking body parts your attacks are highly effective against.
skills.description_zh: 攻击怪物时，如果命中了相对脆弱的有效部位，会心率就会提升。

skills.name: Repeat Offender
skills.description: Increases Affinity following repeated attacks.
skills.description_zh: 连续攻击命中时会心率提升。

skills.name: Status Crit
skills.description: Increases abnormal status attack potency (Paralysis, Poison, Sleep) of your critical hits.
skills.description_zh: 攻击触发会心时，所造成的状态异常值（麻痹、毒、睡眠）会更高。

skills.name: Elemental Crit
skills.description: Increases elemental damage (Fire, Water, Thunder, Ice, Dragon) of your critical hits.
skills.description_zh: 攻击触发会心时，所造成的属性伤害（火、水、雷、冰、龙）会更高。

skills.name: Critical Boost
skills.description: Increases the damage of critical hits.
skills.description_zh: 会心攻击时伤害更高。

skills.name: Bitter Affinity
skills.description: Negative Affinity attacks have a chance to be strong Affinity attacks.
skills.description_zh: 造成的负会心有一定概率变成强力的会心。

skills.name: Focus
skills.description: Speeds L.Sword/C.Blade/D.Blades/ S.Axe gauges, L.Bowgun Arts, and G.Sword/Hammer/Bow charge attacks.
skills.description_zh: 提高太刀、双剑、斩击斧、盾斧能量槽的积攒速度。轻弩炮特定狩技、大剑、大锤、弓蓄力更快。

skills.name: Distraction
skills.description: Slows L.Sword/D.Blades/S.Axe/C.Blade gauges, L.Bowgun Hunter Arts, and G.Sword/Hammer/Bow charge attacks.
skills.description_zh: 降低太刀、双剑、斩击斧、盾斧能量槽的积攒速度。轻弩炮特定狩技、大剑、大锤、弓蓄力更慢。

skills.name: Marathon Runner
skills.description: Slows down Stamina depletion for actions which continuously drain Stamina (such as dashing).
skills.description_zh: 进行奔跑等缓慢消耗耐力的行动时，耐力消耗量会降低。

skills.name: Short Sprinter
skills.description: Speeds up Stamina depletion for actions which continuously drain Stamina (such as dashing).
skills.description_zh: 进行奔跑等缓慢消耗耐力的行动时，耐力消耗量会提高。

skills.name: Constitution +2
skills.description: Greatly slows down Stamina depletion when evading, blocking, etc.
skills.description_zh: 闪避或格挡时，耐力消耗量会大幅降低。

skills.name: Constitution +1
skills.description: Slows down Stamina depletion when evading, blocking, etc.
skills.description_zh: 闪避或格挡时耐力消耗量会降低。

skills.name: Constitution -1
skills.description: Speeds up Stamina depletion when evading, blocking, etc.
skills.description_zh: 闪避或格挡时耐力消耗量会提高。

skills.name: Constitution -2
skills.description: Greatly speeds up Stamina depletion when evading, blocking, etc.
skills.description_zh: 闪避或格挡时，耐力消耗量会大幅提高。

skills.name: Stam Recov Up
skills.description: Increases Stamina recovery speed.
skills.description_zh: 耐力的回复速度加快。

skills.name: Stam Recov Down
skills.description: Decreases Stamina recovery speed.
skills.description_zh: 耐力的回复速度变慢。

skills.name: Endurance Runner
skills.description: Stops Stamina depletion below a certain point while dashing, allowing for a longer dash.
skills.description_zh: 奔跑时耐力只消耗固定值，可以持续奔跑。

skills.name: Evasion +2
skills.description: Extends the invulnerability period when evading.
skills.description_zh: 闪避时的无敌时间更长。

skills.name: Evasion +1
skills.description: Slightly extends the invulnerability period when evading.
skills.description_zh: 闪避时的无敌时间稍微变长。

skills.name: Evasion Down
skills.description: Reduces the invulnerability period when evading.
skills.description_zh: 闪避时的无敌时间更短。

skills.name: Evade Extender
skills.description: Increases evade distance.
skills.description_zh: 闪避时的移动距离更长。

skills.name: Bubbly Dance
skills.description: Evading covers you in bubbles, improving your ability to dodge enemy attacks.
skills.description_zh: 闪避时使自身进入泡沫状态。在泡沫状态下闪避能力更强。

skills.name: Guard +2
skills.description: Greatly increases the likelihood of standing your ground when blocking an attack.
skills.description_zh: 大幅度减轻格挡时的硬直。

skills.name: Guard +1
skills.description: Increases the likelihood of standing your ground when blocking an attack.
skills.description_zh: 减轻格挡时的硬直。

skills.name: Guard -1
skills.description: Decreases the likelihood of standing your ground when blocking an attack.
skills.description_zh: 增加格挡时的硬直。

skills.name: Guard Up
skills.description: Causes previously unblockable attacks to become blockable.
skills.description_zh: 可以格挡各种一般无法格挡的攻击。

skills.name: Knockout King
skills.description: Makes it easier to stun monsters.
skills.description_zh: 更容易使怪物进入昏厥状态。

skills.name: Stamina Thief
skills.description: Increases certain attacks' ability to Exhaust monsters.
skills.description_zh: 使用特定的攻击时更容易使怪物疲劳。

skills.name: Horn Maestro
skills.description: Decreases the likelihood of Horn/Flute items breaking, and increases the effect time of Hunting Horn melodies.
skills.description_zh: 笛类道具更难损坏，狩猎笛的旋律效果和持续时间也更长。

skills.name: Artillery Expert
skills.description: Boosts Ballistae, Crag shots, Impact Phials, Shells, etc. Makes the Heat Gauge more manageable.
skills.description_zh: 弩炮、穿甲榴弹、榴弹瓶、炮击等攻击的威力提升，也更容易控制热量槽。

skills.name: Artillery Novice
skills.description: Slightly boosts Ballistae, Crag shots, Impact Phials, Shells, etc. Makes the Heat Gauge more manageable.
skills.description_zh: 弩炮、穿甲榴弹、榴弹瓶、炮击等攻击的威力略有提升，也更容易控制热量槽。

skills.name: Partbreaker
skills.description: Makes it easier to break or sever parts of monsters.
skills.description_zh: 更容易破坏怪物的部位。

skills.name: Bombardier
skills.description: Increases bomb damage, and raises the Combination success rate for all bombs to 100%.
skills.description_zh: 爆弹类道具的伤害增加。另外爆弹类道具的调和成功率变为100%。

skills.name: Latent Power +2
skills.description: Greatly empowers you for a limited time when certain conditions are met.
skills.description_zh: 满足特定条件后，一定时间内玩家得到大幅度的强化。

skills.name: Latent Power +1
skills.description: Empowers you for a limited time when certain conditions are met.
skills.description_zh: 满足特定条件后，一定时间内玩家得到强化。

skills.name: Challenger +2
skills.description: Greatly increases Attack and Affinity when a large monster in the same area becomes angry.
skills.description_zh: 同一区域内的大型怪物愤怒时玩家的攻击力和会心率会大幅提升。

skills.name: Challenger +1
skills.description: Increases Attack and Affinity when a large monster in the same area becomes angry.
skills.description_zh: 同一区域内的大型怪物愤怒时玩家的攻击力和会心率会提升。

skills.name: Peak Performance
skills.description: Increases Attack when your Health Gauge is full.
skills.description_zh: 当体力全满时攻击力提升。

skills.name: Trump Card
skills.description: Increases Hunter Art power during fights with large monsters when the chance arises.
skills.description_zh: 和大型怪物战斗时一旦抓住机会，狩技的效果就会有所增强。

skills.name: Dragonheart
skills.description: When Health falls below 2/3, you'll get Dragonblight but elemental resistance and Attack increases.
skills.description_zh: 当体力降低到上限的2/3时会进入龙属性异常，同时增加属性耐性和攻击力。

skills.name: Adrenaline +2
skills.description: Greatly increases Attack and Defense when Health is below 40% of the maximum amount.
skills.description_zh: 当体力降低到上限40%以下时，防御力和攻击力大幅提升。

skills.name: Adrenaline +1
skills.description: Greatly increases Defense when Health is below 40% of the maximum amount.
skills.description_zh: 当体力降低到上限40%以下时，防御力大幅提升。

skills.name: Worrywart
skills.description: Decreases Defense boost and Attack when Health is below 40% of maximum.
skills.description_zh: 当体力降低到上限40%以下时，防御力提升的效果降低，攻击力也会降低。

skills.name: Fortify
skills.description: Increases your Attack and Defense every time you fall in battle.
skills.description_zh: 每次力尽倒地后攻击力和防御力都会提升。

skills.name: Resentment
skills.description: Increases Attack when your Health Gauge is in the red.
skills.description_zh: 体力槽出现红色槽时攻击力会提升。

skills.name: Resuscitate
skills.description: Increases Attack when you are suffering from abnormal status.
skills.description_zh: 身处异常状态时攻击力会提升。

skills.name: Guts
skills.description: Prevents fainting a single time if struck with a lethal blow when a certain amount of Health remains.
skills.description_zh: 当体力高于一定水平时，即使受到超量伤害也不会力尽倒地。

skills.name: Sneak
skills.description: Decreases the likelihood of being targeted by monsters.
skills.description_zh: 不容易成为怪物的目标。

skills.name: Taunt
skills.description: Increases the likelihood of being targeted by monsters.
skills.description_zh: 容易成为怪物的目标。

skills.name: Palico Rally
skills.description: Increases the Attack and Defense of Palicoes.
skills.description_zh: 随从的攻击力和防御力提升。

skills.name: Palico Cheer
skills.description: Allows "Fist Pump" gesture to call back fainted/recovering Palicoes. Cannot be used repeatedly.
skills.description_zh: 使用动作“呼喊”后随从会完全回复，撤退中的随从也会马上出战。不能连续使用。

skills.name: Mounting Master
skills.description: Makes it easier to mount and successfully topple a monster.
skills.description_zh: 更容易骑乘怪物，骑乘时更容易成功。

skills.name: Saddle Sore
skills.description: Makes it harder to mount and successfully topple a monster.
skills.description_zh: 更难骑乘怪物，骑乘时更难成功。

skills.name: Airborne
skills.description: Increases the damage caused by Jumping Attacks.
skills.description_zh: 强化跳跃攻击。

skills.name: Composed
skills.description: Makes it easier to fill the Arts Gauge, Valor Gauge, and Alchemy Gauge.
skills.description_zh: 更容易积攒狩技槽、英勇槽和炼金槽。

skills.name: Chance Seizer
skills.description: Fills the Arts Gauge, Valor Gauge and Alchemy Gauge when damage is received.
skills.description_zh: 受到怪物的伤害时也能积攒狩技槽、英勇槽和炼金槽。

skills.name: Longer SP
skills.description: Extends the effect time of the SP State triggered by SP Hunter Arts.
skills.description_zh: 发动SP狩技进入SP状态时持续时间更长。

skills.name: Autotracker
skills.description: Large monsters always display on the Map, as if they were marked.
skills.description_zh: 大型怪物会以被染色弹命中的状态在地图上标记出来。

skills.name: Detect
skills.description: Increases the information displayed on the Map when large monsters are marked.
skills.description_zh: 大型怪物被染色时在地图上会显示更多信息。

skills.name: Capture Guru
skills.description: Grants knowledge of when a large monster can be captured.
skills.description_zh: 可以看见能捕获大型怪物的提示。

skills.name: Outdoorsman
skills.description: Always shows the Map, even if you don't have one. Easier to fish and BBQ meat.
skills.description_zh: 在任务中的钓鱼和烤肉都得心应手，即使不携带地图道具也能看到地图。

skills.name: Pro Transporter
skills.description: Increases your speed while transporting items and decreases the likelihood of dropping them.
skills.description_zh: 搬运时的移动速度增加，即使从相当的高度跳落也不会让搬运物摔坏。

skills.name: Divine Blessing
skills.description: Sometimes decreases damage taken.
skills.description_zh: 一定概率减少玩家所受的伤害。

skills.name: Demonic Blessing
skills.description: Sometimes increases damage taken.
skills.description_zh: 一定概率增加玩家所受的伤害。

skills.name: Hero's Talisman
skills.description: Negates the damage from minor enemy attacks.
skills.description_zh: 免疫所有轻微的伤害。

skills.name: Recovery Up
skills.description: Increases the amount recovered when recovering Health.
skills.description_zh: 增加体力回复时的回复量。

skills.name: Recovery Down
skills.description: Decreases the amount recovered when recovering Health.
skills.description_zh: 降低体力回复时的回复量。

skills.name: Recovery Spd +2
skills.description: Greatly speeds recovery from temporary damage (the red portion of the Health Gauge).
skills.description_zh: 受到伤害后，红色槽的回复速度大幅度提高。

skills.name: Recovery Spd +1
skills.description: Speeds recovery from temporary damage (the red portion of the Health Gauge).
skills.description_zh: 受到伤害后，红色槽的回复速度提高。

skills.name: Recovery Spd -1
skills.description: Slows recovery from temporary damage (the red portion of the Health Gauge).
skills.description_zh: 受到伤害后，红色槽的回复速度降低。

skills.name: Recovery Spd -2
skills.description: Greatly slows recovery from temporary damage (the red portion of the Health Gauge).
skills.description_zh: 受到伤害后，红色槽的回复速度大幅度降低。

skills.name: Item Use Up
skills.description: Increases the effect time of certain items.
skills.description_zh: 部分道具的有效时间延长。

skills.name: Item Use Down
skills.description: Decreases the effect time of certain items.
skills.description_zh: 部分道具的有效时间缩短。

skills.name: Wide-Range +2
skills.description: Transfers the effects of certain items to companions in the same area.
skills.description_zh: 部分道具的效果会作用在同区域的同伴身上。

skills.name: Wide-Range +1
skills.description: Transfers a portion of the effects of certain items to companions in the same area.
skills.description_zh: 部分道具的效果会少量作用在同区域的同伴身上。

skills.name: Negate Hunger
skills.description: Negates maximum Stamina depletion over time.
skills.description_zh: 耐力槽上限不会随着时间减少。

skills.name: Halve Hunger
skills.description: Halves the speed of maximum Stamina depletion over time.
skills.description_zh: 耐力槽上限随时间减少的速度减半。

skills.name: Raise Hunger
skills.description: Speeds maximum Stamina depletion over time.
skills.description_zh: 耐力槽上限随时间减少的速度增加。

skills.name: Double Hunger
skills.description: Greatly speeds up maximum Stamina depletion over time.
skills.description_zh: 耐力槽上限随时间减少的速度大幅度增加。

skills.name: Scavenger
skills.description: Gives any item you eat or drink the potential to also raise your maximum Stamina.
skills.description_zh: 无论吃下什么都能增加耐力槽。

skills.name: Gourmand
skills.description: Increases the efficacy of meat that raises maximum Stamina.
skills.description_zh: 提高肉类道具增加耐力槽上限的效果。

skills.name: Speed Eating +2
skills.description: Increases meat-eating and item-consuming speed.
skills.description_zh: 食用肉和各类道具的速度更快。

skills.name: Speed Eating +1
skills.description: Increases meat-eating speed.
skills.description_zh: 食用肉的速度更快。

skills.name: Slow Eater
skills.description: Decreases meat-eating speed.
skills.description_zh: 食用肉的速度更慢。

skills.name: Rationer
skills.description: Sometimes allows you to reuse items after you eat and drink them.
skills.description_zh: 食用类和饮用类道具有一定概率能再次使用。

skills.name: Meat Lover
skills.description: Raw Meat becomes edible. Rare and Well-done Steaks temporarily grant unlimited Stamina.
skills.description_zh: 可以吃下生肉，食用半生肉和烤熟的肉后一小段时间内获得狂奔效果。

skills.name: Mushromancer
skills.description: Allows the consumption of mushrooms which grant certain benefits as a result.
skills.description_zh: 可以吃下蘑菇，食用蘑菇后可以获得各种效果。

skills.name: Pro Herbology
skills.description: Increases the amount of Health recovered from eating Herbs even more than the Herbology skill.
skills.description_zh: 吃下草药时的回复效果会比“药草强化”更高。

skills.name: Herbology
skills.description: Increases the amount of Health recovered from eating Herbs.
skills.description_zh: 吃下药草时的回复效果有所提高。

skills.name: Combination +45%
skills.description: Increases your Combination success rate by 45%.
skills.description_zh: 调和的成功率增加45%。

skills.name: Combination +20%
skills.description: Increases your Combination success rate by 20%.
skills.description_zh: 调和的成功率增加20%。

skills.name: Combination -10%
skills.description: Decreases your Combination success rate by 10%.
skills.description_zh: 调和的成功率降低10%。

skills.name: Combination -20%
skills.description: Decreases your Combination success rate by 20%.
skills.description_zh: 调和的成功率降低20%。

skills.name: Combination Pro
skills.description: Guarantees maximum results with Combinations that can produce more than one item at a time.
skills.description_zh: 诸如弩的弹药等调和结果数量有波动的情况下，调和的生产数必定是最大值。

skills.name: Trap Master
skills.description: Guarantees trap Combinations will succeed, and speeds up trap- and bomb-setting time.
skills.description_zh: 陷阱道具的调和成功率变为100%，设置陷阱和大型爆弹的速度加快。

skills.name: Gathering +2
skills.description: Often raises the number of times items can be gathered at Gathering Points.
skills.description_zh: 有很高的概率增加道具采集点的采集次数。

skills.name: Gathering +1
skills.description: Sometimes raises the number of times items can be gathered at Gathering Points.
skills.description_zh: 道具采集点的采集次数更容易增加。

skills.name: Gathering -1
skills.description: Sometimes lowers the number of times items can be gathered at Gathering Points.
skills.description_zh: 道具采集点的采集次数更容易减少。

skills.name: Honey Hunter
skills.description: Allows you to gather two Honeys or Royal Honeys at once.
skills.description_zh: 可以一次采集2份蜂蜜和皇家蜂蜜。

skills.name: Charm Chaser
skills.description: Allows you to mine two Charms at once... Maybe.
skills.description_zh: 可以一次采掘2个护符……大概吧。

skills.name: Charm Collector
skills.description: Allows you to mine two Charms at once... Maaaybe.
skills.description_zh: 可以一次采掘2个护符……大概吧。

skills.name: Divine Whim
skills.description: Greatly decreases the likelihood of Pickaxes, Bug Nets, Boomerangs, Flutes, and Horns breaking.
skills.description_zh: 十字镐、捕虫网、回力标、笛类道具非常不容易损坏。

skills.name: Spirit's Whim
skills.description: Decreases the likelihood of Pickaxes, Bug Nets, Boomerangs, Flutes, and Horns breaking.
skills.description_zh: 十字镐、捕虫网、回力标、笛类道具不容易损坏。

skills.name: Spectre's Whim
skills.description: Increases the likelihood of Pickaxes, Bug Nets, Boomerang, Flutes, and Horns breaking.
skills.description_zh: 十字镐、捕虫网、回力标、笛类道具容易损坏。

skills.name: Devil's Whim
skills.description: Greatly increases the likelihood of Pickaxes, Bug Nets, Boomerangs, Flutes, and Horns breaking.
skills.description_zh: 十字镐、捕虫网、回力标、笛类道具非常容易损坏。

skills.name: Miraculous Luck
skills.description: Very often increases the number of Reward Items received at the end of a Quest.
skills.description_zh: 有最高的概率能增加任务报酬中获得的道具数。

skills.name: Great Luck
skills.description: Often increases the number of Reward Items received at the end of a Quest.
skills.description_zh: 有很高的概率能增加任务报酬中获得的道具数。

skills.name: Good Luck
skills.description: Sometimes increases the number of Reward Items received at the end of a Quest.
skills.description_zh: 有一定的概率能增加任务报酬中获得的道具数。

skills.name: Bad Luck
skills.description: Sometimes decreases the number of Reward Items received at the end of a Quest.
skills.description_zh: 有一定的概率会减少任务报酬中获得的道具数。

skills.name: Horrible Luck
skills.description: Often decreases the number of Reward Items received at the end of a Quest.
